description: run the same candidate SQL against mysqld built at the parent revision and at the target revision (identical Debug+ENABLE_GCOV flags) and flag an observable behavioral difference: result-set difference (order-insensitive), success/error outcome difference, crash difference, or both-error message difference; a difference selects the candidate for study and is not by itself a bug
evidence_basis: two gcov-instrumented mysqld builds at the exact parent and target revisions; identical data, configuration and session order on both sides; per-candidate execution logs, result sets and diff classification recorded as raw_evidence
